verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms supports a narrow form of recurring automation via managed payout schedules ('create a managed payout schedule for your balance platform and apply it to balance accounts with the same location and currency') and automated payout logic, which is a recurring scheduled process. However, this is limited strictly to payout timing/logic and does not constitute general-purpose recurring job or workflow scheduling for AI-native automation use cases. Missing for 10: a general workflow/job scheduler or automation engine beyond payout scheduling, API/SDK support for defining arbitrary recurring tasks, and any AI-native orchestration hooks tied to scheduling.
